description: This file implements a logging utility module in C for the HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer). It provides functions for message logging with different levels, initializes logging based on environment or file presence, and ensures cleanup at unload.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_Logger_Message(eMessageLevel level,const char * function,int line,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Formats and outputs log messages based on severity level, function name, and line number, with optional verbose logging.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleInit()
methods.description: Initializes logging settings, enabling verbose logging if specific files or environment variables are present.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleTerminate()
methods.description: Performs cleanup and logs termination message upon unloading.
